Guardian — published 11:00 BST 26 Sep 2026 (06:00 EDT), last modified 11:02 BST. By Aram Roston in Washington.

HEADLINE: The truth behind Donald Trump's 'biggest oil deal in world history'
STANDFIRST: The US's oil deal with Venezuela faces multiple legal and logistical problems, including questions about whether it can be implemented

Donald Trump has long coveted the oilfields of other nations and declared an agreement with Venezuela to be "the biggest oil deal in world history". But the deal, reached after the US seized Venezuelan president Nicolas Maduro, is almost certainly doomed to collapse amid a wide array of legal and logistical issues, a Guardian investigation has found.
